problem: Root cause of release drift is now identified. The production checkout's scripts/zero-downtime-build.js intentionally treated /var/www/cutinapp.petertecnet.com.br as a special case and copied a locally compiled staging build directly into the live build directory. Files in live build were rewritten at 2026-09-25 03:26:05 UTC while release-sha.txt retained its older 2026-09-23 timestamp/SHA. The VPS checkout reflog shows a local rebase finishing at 03:23:13 UTC, immediately before the live build rewrite. Therefore a local npm run build in the production checkout could overwrite the validated GitHub Actions artifact without updating release-sha.txt.
impact: A producer could receive frontend bytes that did not correspond to the SHA validated by CI, invalidating activation/conversion measurements and making production behavior nondeterministic.
solution: Commit 0de0a0129e6aa6612bbc1d8b23f1fa2c584e3431 changes zero-downtime-build.js to refuse direct builds from the production root by default. GitHub-hosted builds and explicit BUILD_PATH builds remain supported. An emergency escape hatch CUTINAPP_ALLOW_DIRECT_PRODUCTION_BUILD=1 exists but normal production delivery must use the validated Deploy VPS workflow.
evidence: Production build directory stat shows index/assets rewritten at 03:26:05 UTC while release-sha.txt was not rewritten.
VPS git reflog shows local main rebased onto origin/main at 03:23:13 UTC and remains locally divergent.
The prior zero-downtime-build.js explicitly called publishWithoutDowntime(stagingPath) when appRoot equaled /var/www/cutinapp.petertecnet.com.br.
The official reusable deployment already builds on GitHub, embeds the validated SHA, atomically swaps the complete build directory and verifies the public release SHA.
Commit 0de0a012 adds a fail-closed guard preventing ordinary npm run build from publishing into the live production build directory.
risk: Do not claim production fixed until Validate Cutinapp succeeds, Deploy VPS publishes the fix SHA, and public release-sha.txt equals that SHA.
gate_status: IMPLEMENTING: root cause fixed in main; CI/deploy/production verification pending.
next_independent_blocker: Wait for Validate Cutinapp on 0de0a012, allow the gated Deploy VPS workflow to publish only if validation succeeds, then verify origin/public release-sha.txt equals the deployed main SHA. After deterministic release is restored, resume producer activation and subscription conversion work.
